description: Rolled when a Zhodani Consulate career Event roll results in 'Life Event'. Roll 2D.

2.title: Sickness or Injury
2.text: You are injured or contract a serious illness. Roll on the Injury table.

3.title: Birth or Death
3.text: Someone close to you dies, such as a friend or family member. Alternatively, someone close to you gives birth (or is born!). You are involved in some fashion (father or mother, relative, godparent, etc).

4.title: End of Relationship
4.text: A romantic relationship involving you ends. Roll 1D: On a 1-2 your partner is killed. On a 3-4 your partner leaves. On a 5-6 you leave your partner.

5.title: Improved Relationship
5.text: A romantic relationship involving you deepens, possibly leading to marriage or some other emotional commitment. Gain an Ally.

6.title: New Relationship
6.text: You become romantically involved with an existing Ally or Contact. If you have no Contacts or Allies, gain an Ally.

8.title: Betrayal
8.text: You are betrayed in some fashion by a friend or colleague. If you have any Contacts or Allies, convert one into a Rival or Enemy. Otherwise, gain a Rival or an Enemy.

9.title: Travel
9.text: You move to another world and gain DM+2 to your next Qualification roll.

10.title: Good Fortune
10.text: Something good happens to you; you come into money unexpectedly, have a lifelong dream come true, get a book published or have some other stroke of good fortune. Gain a Benefit roll in your current career.

11.title: Crime
11.text: You commit or are accused of a crime. Roll SOC 8+. If failed, lose one Benefit roll and roll on the Re-education Events table.

12.title: Unusual Event
12.text: Something unusual occurs. Roll 1D: 1=Psionics: An event affects you, granting PSI +2. If you are a Prole and this increases PSI above 8, you are elevated to the Intendant class (raising your SOC to 10). 2=Aliens: You spend time among an alien race. Gain Language 1 and a Contact with a member of that race. 3=Alien Artefact: You come into possession of a curious piece of alien technology or an archaeological relic. 4=Amnesia: Something happened to you but you do not know what it was. Roll on the Re-education Events table regardless of SOC. 5=Contact with Government: You have brief contact with the highest echelons of Consulate government. Gain one Benefit roll in your current career. 6=Ancient Technology: You have an item believed to be left behind by the Ancients. Because it interacts with you in a unique fashion, you have been allowed to keep it but both the item and you remain objects of occasional study.

re_education_events.name: Re-education Events
re_education_events.note: Rolled when triggered by certain mishaps or life events. Does not count as career time for benefits/advancement/skills but does count for aging.

results.1: Re-education requires two terms. You must enter a new career and reduce END by -1. If SOC 11+, reduce SOC by -1 to a minimum of 11.
results.2: Re-education requires one term. You must enter a new career and reduce END by -1. If SOC 11+, reduce SOC by -1 to a minimum of 11.
results.3: Re-education requires one term but you can continue this career.
results.4: Re-education requires less than a year and your career is not affected.
results.5: Fine of Cr1000 x 1D; you do not require re-education.
results.6: Exonerated! Receive an additional Benefit roll in your current career.
